name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: The tick draws itself in, the box squishes on press and a ring bursts out. Labels, descriptions and to-do strike-through.
summary: A checkbox whose tick draws itself in as the box squishes and a ring bursts out.
usage:
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';

<Checkbox
  label="Email me about new releases"
  description="About once a month, never spam."
  defaultChecked
/>
behavior: The whole row toggles. The box squishes on press-in and bounces back on release.
The fill and tick spring in together, and a ring bursts outward each time it becomes checked.
A checkbox with checked and disabled state.
props: Strike the label through when checked.
Rounded square (corner = size / 3.4) or full circle.
Box width and height in points; the tick is 80% of it.
Style for the pressable row holding the box and label.
